name: Anchore SBOM Action
description: Creates an SBOM (Software Bill Of Materials) from your code and container images

path.description: A path to a directory on the filesystem to scan

file.description: A file on the filesystem to scan

github-token.description: Authorized secret GitHub Personal Access Token. Defaults to github.token

artifact-name.description: The name to use for the SBOM file generated by this action

output-file.description: A file location to output the SBOM

syft-version.description: The version of Syft to use

dependency-snapshot.description: Upload to GitHub dependency snapshot API

upload-artifact-retention.description:
